title: Version 1.59.0
body:
Version 1.59.0

June 24th, 2024

Added:

  • Added various billboards tips around the map for information
  • Added a setting to hide billboard tips around the map
  • Added an anchoring option to Build Mode, and Inspect Menu
  • Added Vehicle flipping (press V)
  • Re-added Vehicle steering wheel IK
  • Added report option to property signs for NSFW builds (abuse will result in a ban)

Changed:

  • You can now modify vehicles by interacting with a license plate!
  • Topbar now adapts to older Roblox clients
  • You can now press X (or 5) to enter delete mode

Fixed:

  • Jenna is happy now! (Face has been fixed)

Version 1.59.1

June 24th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Major bug fixes
